messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — ran a quick audit of the admin workbench and found ~7k accounts with onboarding_state=null. Would like to run a targeted hygiene backfill + healthscore recalibration. Can we canary first?

sam: Yep. What filter do you want to use for the canary (1k)?

marta: Proposed filter: 
```sql
SELECT id, email, created_at FROM accounts
WHERE onboarding_state IS NULL
  AND created_at >= '2023-01-01'
  AND region = 'NA'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```

kevin: Sounds good. We should run it via admin-backfill job with --dry-run=false but a canary flag. I can add a rollback toggle and quota limiter so we don't thrash playbook runner.

marta: :thumbsup: Can you schedule the canary tomorrow 02:00 PST? We'll monitor healthscore deltas and playbook trigger counts for 2 hours.

lina: Add a step to capture pre/post sample for the onboarding eval promptset. We need to include at least 200 sampled accounts for quality checks.

cs-bot: Job queued: admin-backfill v2 (canary=1000, region=NA) — job_id=jb_8812 — scheduled for 2024-04-18T02:00:00-08:00.

marta: Also noticed occasional duplicate playbook triggers when contact.email updates. Suspect webhook duplicates firing on the downstream sync.

sam: Saw logs showing repeated receipts: "webhook: duplicate_fire". Small snippet: 
```
2024-04-17T21:12:02Z WARN webhook-handler duplicate_fire id=acct_12345 hook=email_update
2024-04-17T21:12:02Z INFO playbook-run queued rule=welcome_nudge account=acct_12345
```

kevin: I'll add an idempotency key on the webhook consumer and instrument the admin-backfill to honor it. Will post a short RFC in #eng-platform this afternoon.

marta: Great. Can you include a toggle to run the backfill in "patch" mode that only writes fields if onboarding_state is null (no overwrites)? That'll keep it safe.

sam: Please create a CS backlog ticket and flag as medium. I'll own monitoring during the canary window and post hourly snapshots to this thread.

marta: I'll DM the 5 sample accounts to you for the first sanity checks. Thanks everyone!
